plain: Bossy and expecting to be obeyed.

webster.text: Commanding; dictatorial; haughty; arrogant; overbearing; domineering; as an imperious tyrant; an imperious dictator; an imperious man; an imperious temper.

more.text: Commanding; indicating an imperious temper; authoritative; as imperious words.
Powerful; overbearing; not to be opposed by obstacles; as a man of a vast and imperious mind.
Commanding; urgent; pressing; as imperious love; imperious circumstances; imperious appetite.

example.quote: Has it not, on the contrary, invariably been found that momentary passions, and immediate interest, have a more active and imperious control over human conduct than general or remote considerations of policy, utility or justice?
